SELECT
  'ce-' || '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}' || '-client_expense-' || replace(replace('${datetime}','-',''),'_','T') || 'Z' AS batch_id,
  '${ENV:SYSTEM_BOOK}' AS system_book,
  CAST('${date-1d}' AS DATE) AS bizday,
  CAST(o.other_inout_bill_no AS VARCHAR) AS other_inout_bill_no,
  CAST(o.branch_num AS INTEGER) AS branch_num,
  CAST(o.branch_name AS VARCHAR) AS branch_name,
  CAST(o.client_fid AS VARCHAR) AS client_fid,
  CAST(o.client_code AS VARCHAR) AS client_code,
  CAST(o.client_name AS VARCHAR) AS client_name,
  CAST(o.other_inout_flag AS BOOLEAN) AS other_inout_flag,
  CAST(o.other_inout_flag_name AS VARCHAR) AS other_inout_flag_name,
  CAST(o.other_inout_kind AS VARCHAR) AS other_inout_kind,
  CAST(o.other_inout_kind_code AS VARCHAR) AS other_inout_kind_code,
  CAST(o.other_inout_date AS VARCHAR) AS other_inout_date,
  CAST(o.other_inout_money AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS other_inout_money,
  CAST(o.other_inout_due_money AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS other_inout_due_money,
  CAST(o.other_inout_ref_bill AS VARCHAR) AS other_inout_ref_bill,
  CAST(o.other_inout_audit_time AS VARCHAR) AS other_inout_audit_time,
  CAST(json_extract_string(CAST(o.state AS JSON), '$.state_code') AS INTEGER) AS state_code,
  CAST(o.other_inout_memo AS VARCHAR) AS other_inout_memo
FROM input o
